entities.summary: King Abdullah Sports City Stadium Buraydah, also known as Buraydah Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in Buraydah, primarily used for football. It hosts the home matches of Al-Taawoun, Al-Raed, the stadium also accommodates matches for clubs from outside the province in emergency situations.
